definitions.explanation: The act of preventing something from happening or stopping someone from doing something.

examples.japanese: {犯罪|はんざい}を{阻止|そし}する。
{計画|けいかく}の{阻止|そし}に{失敗|しっぱい}した。
examples.english: We failed to stop the plan.

examples.japanese: {市民|しみん}は{開発|かいはつ}を{阻止|そし}するためにデモを{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: Citizens held a demonstration to stop the development.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{犯罪|はんざい}を{阻止|そし}する - to prevent a crime
・{計画|けいかく}を{阻止|そし}する - to stop a plan
・{侵入|しんにゅう}を{阻止|そし}する - to prevent intrusion
・{進行|しんこう}を{阻止|そし}する - to stop the progress

NUANCE:
{阻止|そし} emphasizes the act of stopping or preventing something from happening, while {妨害|ぼうがい} emphasizes interference or obstruction.

RELATED WORDS:
・{妨害|ぼうがい} - obstruction, interference
・{抑止|よくし} - deterrence (preventing through threat)
・{防止|ぼうし} - prevention (more general)
